issue.title: test_artifact_directory_operation_sites_are_reviewed fails: reset_replay.py:_clear_owned_paths is an unreviewed artifact-directory operation site
issue.description: tests/test_agent_artifact_directory_operation_audit.py::test_artifact_directory_operation_sites_are_reviewed fails deterministically (not a flake): the discovered set of artifact-directory-operation contexts contains one extra item vs the reviewed allowlist: 'src/sase/workspace_provider/reset_replay.py:_clear_owned_paths'. Reproduces identically on clean master (HEAD 02bd00833) with a stashed worktree and on branch with unrelated Artifacts TUI grouping changes present, confirming it predates and is unrelated to that work (found 2026-08-16 verifying sase-m6.7.1.5). Someone added or renamed a directory operation in reset_replay.py without adding it to _REVIEWED_DIR_OPERATION_CONTEXTS in the audit test. Fix: review the _clear_owned_paths site for safety and add it to the reviewed context list (or fix the underlying operation first if review finds it unsafe).

evidence.note: Independently reproduced during relation-panel implementation verification on 2026-08-16: .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_agent_artifact_directory_operation_audit.py::test_artifact_directory_operation_sites_are_reviewed fails with extra context src/sase/workspace_provider/reset_replay.py:_clear_owned_paths. This workspace's diff does not touch reset_replay.py or the audit test. Note: active ownership phase sase-mq.8.3 reports this audit entry fixed in its newer work, so this is evidence from a stale branch/workspace still missing that fix.

payload.entry: CURRENT STATE CHANGED (2026-08-16, verified on origin/master a0b6cd16b): the reported symptom no longer reproduces, but the fix landed twice. 'src/sase/workspace_provider/reset_replay.py:_clear_owned_paths' is now present TWICE in _REVIEWED_DIR_OPERATION_CONTEXTS in tests/test_agent_artifact_directory_operation_audit.py, at lines 279 and 292, with DIFFERENT exemption prose. The second entry came from b82f21c1b 'test: register ownership audit coverage' (epic sase-mq, now closed) landing on top of an entry that already existed. Python silently keeps the second, so the audit test itself passes, but ruff now reports F601 'Dictionary key literal repeated' at line 292. That fails 'just fix', which is this project's commit_hooks.before in sase/sase.yml, so it currently blocks EVERY commit in this repo for every agent, not just the audit test. Filed separately because the defect and remediation differ from this bead (missing entry vs duplicated entry).

Independently reviewed src/sase/workspace_provider/reset_replay.py:_clear_owned_paths on current master (30c9ba23b). The rmtree is gated by _require_leased_checkout (LEASED_OPERATIONAL only; refuses primary #0, unclaimed checkouts, and repo_root outside the lease) and then re-checks every caller-supplied path with resolve()+is_relative_to(checkout), so symlink escapes and paths outside the lease raise WorkspaceOwnershipError. The site is already registered once in _REVIEWED_DIR_OPERATION_CONTEXTS (b82f21c1b) with exemption prose that matches that review; no code change needed. Verified: test_artifact_directory_operation_sites_are_reviewed and test_reviewed_dir_operation_sites_declare_coverage pass; test_clear_paths_removes_lease_owned_state_on_reset and test_clear_paths_outside_checkout_are_refused pass; ruff check on the audit test and reset_replay.py is clean (no F601).
